init.title: Custom screens
init.description: Templates for up to 4 custom screens. Each one with text joins the display rotation after the regular screens and updates whenever its template changes. Leave a field empty to remove that screen. Example: `{example}`. Long text scrolls. Needs firmware with custom screen support.

confirm.title: Remove the old HomeBrainz integration
confirm.description:
The HomeBrainz integration is now called inkVision, and your devices were moved to it. HACS left the old integration's folder behind at `{path}`, where it can still discover devices as "HomeBrainz". Until it is gone, the old entries stay under HomeBrainz as disabled; they are removed automatically afterwards.

Select **Submit** to delete the folder, then restart Home Assistant.

legacy_service.title: The {old} action was renamed
legacy_service.description: An automation or script called `{old}`. It still works for now, but please change it to `{new}`, then ignore this notice.

legacy_duplicate.title: {title} is set up twice
legacy_duplicate.description: {title} was added to inkVision and also still exists under the old HomeBrainz name. Remove the HomeBrainz entry under **Settings** > **Devices & services**.

deprecated_action.title: The {action} action is deprecated
deprecated_action.description: An automation or script called `{action}`. It still works for now, but it will be removed in a future release. Use the `{replacement}` action on the device's {entity} entity instead, then ignore this notice.

deprecated_entity.title: An inkVision firmware entity is deprecated

custom_screens_unsupported.message: The firmware of {device} does not support custom screens. Update the firmware first.

update_check_failed.message: Could not check {device} for a firmware update. Check that it is online.

set_brightness.name: Set display brightness
set_brightness.description: Sets the display brightness. Deprecated: use the device's Display brightness entity instead.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: 0 turns the display off, 15 is brightest.

display_text.name: Display text
display_text.description: Shows a message on the display for a while. Deprecated: use the device's Custom message entity instead.

restart_device.name: Restart device
restart_device.description: Restarts the device. Deprecated: use the device's Restart entity instead.

set_screen_rotation.name: Set screen rotation
set_screen_rotation.description: Selects which screens the display rotates through, all at once.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: The screens to rotate through. They are shown in a fixed order.

set_timezone.name: Set timezone
set_timezone.description: Sets the timezone of the device's clock. Deprecated: use the device's Timezone entity instead.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name, for example Europe/Prague.

set_custom_screen.name: Set custom screen
set_custom_screen.description: Sets the text of a custom screen. Screens with text join the display rotation after the regular screens; empty text removes the screen. A slot that has a template in the integration options is overwritten the next time the template changes.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to show, up to 64 characters; longer text scrolls. Leave empty to remove the screen.
